description: 重裝機槍手（heavy_gunner）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 重裝機槍手

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a heavy gunner, very large and broad, about five and a half heads tall: full-body heavy dark grey armor with bulky shoulder pauldrons, a thick chest plate, big forearm guards and knee armor, a closed helmet with a narrow magenta visor, an ammo belt, black boots, heavy gloves, hot-pink neon lines.
